import collections

values := [72, 85, 64, 90, 85, 58, 77, 85, 69, 93, 71]
samples := real64(values)
mean := samples.mean()
ordered := values.sorted()
median := ordered[5]
counts := values.frequencies()
mode, _ := collections.ranked_entries(counts)[0]
spread := ordered[-1] - ordered[0]
real64 squares := 0.0
for sample := samples[]
    difference := sample - mean
    squares += difference * difference
deviation := (squares / #samples) ^ 0.5
println("mean: {mean:.3}{NL}median: {median}{NL}mode: {mode}{NL}range: {spread}{NL}stdev: {deviation:.3}")
